pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakārasamaye bahuṃ suttaṃ viññāpesuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.3: kate pi cīvare bahu suttaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.4: atha kho chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.5: handa mayaṃ āvuso aññaṃ pi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpemā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.6: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aññaṃ pi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpesuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.7: vīte pi cīvare bahu suttaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.8: dutiyam pi kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aññaṃ pi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpesuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.9: vīte pi cīvare bahu suttaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.16: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.17: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.20: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.21: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.22: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
